summary: Backend + frontend E2E testing of RatherKnow Mirror v2 completed. All 15 backend pytest cases pass (instruments listing, four full-lifecycle instrument flows, immutability/double-complete idempotence, validation errors 400/404/409, Flag Check reflection lifecycle including safety yes/unsure/no and insufficient pattern, mirrors summary/findings with 2+ and <2 completions). Frontend Playwright verified landing page, 4 instrument cards + Flag Check fifth door, canonical to ratherknow.com, Closeness Mirror end-to-end (click + keyboard 1-7, single-dot plot, no percentages, no band/percentile/grade/risk-label tokens, evidence tier chip present), localStorage resume (mi2.sessions key confirmed, resumed at question 4/37 after 3 answers), Flag Check flow with safety split above the fold, single flag-cta-essential rule, flag-safety-yes referral block appearing above the CTA when safety='Yes', /mirrors cross-check listing all four instruments and emitting noindex, robots.txt disallowing /mirrors and /results/, sitemap.xml excluding those, /results/* emitting noindex. Content pages /promise (7 promises, 10 refusals via promise-refusal-N), /methodology, /safety, /faq, /learn, /samples, /archetypes, /archetypes/the-rock all render with correct self-referential canonicals.
action_items: The review request references a Learn essay at /learn/relationship-delta, but no article with that slug exists in /app/frontend/src/content/miLearn.js (available slugs: the-interference, the-signal-box, why-you-keep-choosing-the-same-type, dont-waste-the-breakup, the-assessment-that-knows-its-place). The LearnArticle page safely redirects unknown slugs to /learn, so behaviour is fine, but if the 'relationship-delta' essay is intended by the spec, main agent should author it and add it to LEARN_ARTICLES. If not, update the review checklist to reference an existing slug.

Minor observation: the word 'risk' appears once in prose on the Flag Check result page ('The risk for you isn't blindness — it's the opposite…'). This is narrative language, not a score/label — the spec forbids risk LABELS, and no numeric risk value is shown. Flag it only if the copy team wants the noun entirely absent.
critical_code_review_comments: mirror_v2.py is ~660 lines and mixes routes, scoring helpers and Flag Check logic. Consider splitting scoring helpers (_score_essential/_score_eq/_headline/_build_findings) into a services/mirror_v2_scoring.py to keep the routes module under the ~500 line guideline.

In put_responses the response value is validated against len(meta['scale']) — good — but there is no size cap on the responses list length; a client could submit thousands of items in one batch. Consider capping len(data.responses) to something like total_items to prevent abuse.

The results snapshot in /api/v2/assessments/{id}/complete stores the full result in both the session document and the immutable 'results' collection. On second complete, the immutable doc is not touched (upsert with $setOnInsert). That is correct — immutability is preserved. Good.
Frontend Runner.js keyboard handler uses payload.scale.length which is 5 for likert but 7 for closeness — correct. Nice touch.
Landing tier chip uses `bg-[#1C1C18]` for Established but only `border` for Developmental. Contrast is fine, just noting for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Test sessions & reflections are created and left in the DB by pytest tests; they are anonymous and small (~10 docs). No cleanup harness added since immutability is a product invariant we are testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mirror_v2.py is the regression harness — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_mirror_v2.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest-xdist is on by default via pytest.ini and requires disabling for this local suite). Playwright covered Closeness end-to-end + Flag Check end-to-end; long instruments were only exercised via API per the review note. If content changes, verify /promise still shows 10 promise-refusal-N nodes and /faq still has 12 faq-item-N entries.
